name: content
description: A page, either regular or a shell for use with a blog post.

description.description: An optional short blurb about the page's contents. Displays in search engine results and in social shares. An excerpt of the page content may be used if left blank.

card.description: An optional image that shows up in social shares. The best size is 1200x630 pixels. Different from the hero image used for display on the site.
